title: Colonial Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New england files for review and approval of a 365 Day Firm Transportation Agreement with Baker Commodities Inc.
petitioner: Colonial Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: CORRECTED PAGE - The Department Approved Agreement. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr. and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 02-02)

The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (CG 02-02)
